newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Defiance says will maintain improved profit.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Defiance says will maintain improved profit.

text.p: Defiance Food Industries Ltd on Friday said it expected to maintain its improved profit result this year and to build on it next year.
Defiance reported a NZ$1.25 million profit for the half-year to December 31, up 425 percent on the $294,000 posted in the previous comparable period.
Defiance said its bakeries had benefited from improved margins while its mills maintained performance.
It said trading conditions had not eased at all since its previous report, and the second half of the year would be a challenge.
Defiance said an as-yet unquantifiable restructuring charge was expected at the full year.
